semantics.clock: All state changes on positive clk edges. Moore outputs reflect the state entered immediately after sampling the completing bit and hold for the ensuing full cycle.
semantics.reset: Active high synchronous; sampled reset sets state equivalent to previous input 0 and clears all outputs.

patterns.disc: Zero completing exactly five consecutive ones asserts disc for one cycle.
patterns.flag: Zero completing exactly six consecutive ones asserts flag for one cycle.
patterns.err: Seventh and each subsequent consecutive one asserts err; next zero clears err.

semantics.overlap: Completing zero also starts the next run; recognition continues on every bit.
semantics.initialization: No initial state specified before the first sampled reset; no power-up initialization added.
semantics.evidence: Original specifies 0111110, 01111110, 01111111..., Moore-type FSM, positive edges, active high synchronous reset, complete-cycle outputs.

numeric.run_length: Track 0 through 7 consecutive ones, saturating at 7.
numeric.state_space: Run states plus distinct discard and flag states.

verification.oracle: Independent integer run-length model derived from original patterns.
verification.sampling: Drive at falling edges; verify unchanged outputs before rising edge and expected outputs after rising edge.
cases: All run lengths 0 through 20 followed by zero
Reset during partial runs and asserted outputs
Deterministic pseudorandom stream with reset interruptions
verification.success: Fatal on mismatch; bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Phrase beginning on clock cycle after condition occurs
specification_ambiguities.interpretation: The completing bit is sampled on a rising edge; Moore output is asserted in the cycle immediately following that edge, with no additional pipeline cycle. This follows Moore recognition and no extra latency.
No guaranteed initial outputs are assumed; tests begin with synchronous reset.
